tagline: Soma mu ndimi zitandukanye. Gumana uburemere buke.
selectionHint: Hitamwo ijambo, interuro canke paragarafu. Ushobora kandi gukanda iburyo.
appHint: Impinduro z'interface zishirwa hamwe zitari ku murongo. Bimwebimwe bihindurwa n’imashini. Amazina y’indimi akurikira ururimi rwa porogaramu rwatowe.
fallback: Niba Bing inanirwa, gerageza Google (yohereza umwandiko kuri Google)
dynamicHint: Ibirimwo biboneka ni vyo bishirwa imbere. Guhagarika kurekura abarorerezi.
ready: Fyonda kuri Guhindura kugira ngo utangure.
languageReset: Ururimi rwa kera ntiruboneka kuri iyi moteri; ururimi rwahisemwo rwahinduwe.
message1: Kode y'ururimi ntaco imaze. Koresha id, ru, ja, zh-CN, n’ibindi.
message3: Uzuza urufunguzo rwa API rw'umutanga mu Miterere.
message5: — Imipaka y’ivyo umuntu asaba/ivyo asaba. Subira ugerageze hanyuma.
message6: Uwutanga ntagarukana ubuhinduzi. Suzuma akarorero, ururimi n’igice.
message8: Ico gice ntikigira akamaro canke ni kinini cane.
message9: Igitigiri c'ibisubizo vya Bing batch ntigihuye.
message10: Ivyavuye mu bice vya Bing ntibifise akamaro.
message12: Ivyanditswe bitagiramwo ikintu canke inyuguti zirenga 12.000.
message27: Uwo mukozi w’igikorwa ntaco ariko arishura.
message34: Uwutanga ahindura uburyo ikimenyetso giteye. Igipande c’intango kiragumwa.
message38: Ivyerekana birabuze ku bisubizo. Igipande c’intango kiragumwa.
message43: Paje yose ikoreshwa mu bice bihuye.
message44: Uwo mutanga yarananiwe mu bice 3. Fyonda guhindura kugira ngo wongere ugerageze.
message49: Igitigiri c'ububiko bw'ibirimwo carashitse. Gusubiza iyo paji imbere yo kubandanya.
message50: Guhindura amapaji ukoresheje imashini n'ururimi bishasha
message53: Fyonda kuri Translate kugira ngo utangure.
message58: Subiramwo iyo extension hanyuma usubiremwo urupapuro kugira ngo ushiremwo verisiyo nshasha.
message61: Vugurura urupapuro iyo hariho ivyungura bishasha.
